About Me

Who I am.

I'm a 3rd-year Software Engineering student at Eastern Mediterranean University in Famagusta, Cyprus — building at the intersection of AI research, product coordination, and software engineering.

In 2020 I started Deaf Vision — an AI sound recognition system for AR glasses to help deaf individuals. By 2022 it placed 1st and 4th nationally at ISEF Palestine and was presented at the World Cup for Innovation & Scientific Research.

In 2024–2025 I worked as a Software Project Coordinator, coordinating two live iOS apps from concept to App Store.
